metadata.name: Constitutional Monarchism
metadata.description: A constitutional tradition retaining a hereditary head of state alongside parliamentary democracy, civil rights and accountable government.
metadata.period: Modern parliamentary constitutional monarchy, UK and Commonwealth reference
metadata.scope: Support for a hereditary, constitutionally limited head of state with an elected and accountable head of government; socioeconomic policies are illustrative applications of a pluralist parliamentary version, not requirements of monarchy. metadata.phrase: Society should retain a constitutionally limited hereditary head of state while elected representatives govern under the law and remain accountable to the public.
